title: Simultaneous Pointwise Majorization for Mixed Tail Processes with Applications in Gaussian Chaos and Ergodic Diffusions
summary: Classical chaining controls an indexed stochastic process through a single worst-case bound and can therefore obscure substantial variation across the index set. We develop the first simultaneous pointwise majorization theory for Banach-valued processes with finite-metric mixed-tail increments.
